name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Huadong Pressure Gauge Company was founded in 1985. For more than 20 years, it has developed rapidly to a modern enterprise with annual production capacity of 5 million gauges by our more than 250 employees.



Its main products include variety of pressure gauges, vacuum gauges, diaphragms, regulators and thermometers. With high quality products and professional service, our products have been exported to many countries and areas, which finally lead to our divisions of different regions, including American Division, European Division, Middle East Division and Asia Division.
